source_caption_text:
#NightLovell stepped outside the usual rap performance format for this one 🔥

Night Lovell brings his signature dark sound to “SICK & TIRED” 🔥🖤

Produced by OUTBY16, the track pairs his deep delivery with heavy production as he addresses one-sided relationships and the frustration of people expecting his time, energy and support without giving the same in return. It’s a blunt message about reaching your limit with people who keep taking. 

The song helped introduce MY BLOOD AS THE INK, released August 28 through G59 Records. The project followed his December 2023 album I HOPE YOU’RE HAPPY, marking his first full-length release in more than two years.
